name: AGAPAY prototype recovery policy
basis: App-owner requested practical defaults for the prototype; physical validation is pending
escalation: Immediate on increasing severity, including a suspicious critical rise; add a review flag rather than suppressing it
recovery: All crossed exit bands must be satisfied; invalid samples, excessive gaps, reboot/session changes or policy changes restart persistence

issuer.name: AGAPAY App Operations
issuer.scope: Application advisories; no public evacuation authority claimed
